  3. Browse photos and videos

Browse photos and videos

There are three ways to find your photos:

  • On the map: turn on photos in Map → Your data, then click a marker. Under Photos, choose the photo you clicked, This cluster, or Map view at tap (all photos visible when you clicked).
  • By activity: open a track's Media tab.
  • By period: in Statistics → Trends, click a media bar.
On this page
  • The viewer

The viewer

If a thumbnail shows Retry, select it to load the image again. Once it loads, select the thumbnail to open the viewer.

  • Move between photos with the side buttons, arrow keys, or by swiping.
  • Zoom and pan the photo.
  • View shows or hides Details, Location map, and Photo strip. Photo only hides them all; Restore panels brings them back.
  • More shows technical information.
  • Expand makes the viewer bigger; Full screen fills the screen. Press Escape or Exit full screen to go back.
  • Download the original file.

All media shows every photo in the time span of your filtered tracks; Track related shows only photos linked to a track. Photos without a date don't appear in date-based views.
